name: Stage-based Differentiable Volume/Radiance Field Training
definition: A stage-based optimization loop for differentiable volume or radiance field reconstruction that alternates between image-based and ray-based sampling modes, applies stochastic preconditioning with exponential alpha decay, and optionally upsamples parameters between stages.
summary: Stage-based Differentiable Volume/Radiance Field Training optimizes fields via alternating sampling modes, stochastic preconditioning, and progressive upsampling to stabilize gradients and reduce memory usage.
